description: The donut chart titled "Stimulus Type" illustrates the distribution of various types of stimuli used in the development of story case studies on generative AI's use in journalism. The chart is composed of eight distinct segments, each representing a different stimulus type and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment, labeled "Draft/Other," accounts for 26.4% and is colored dark red. The second largest segment, "Press Release," represents 18.7% and is colored yellow. The third largest segment, "External News Article," makes up 18.1% and is colored dark green. Other notable segments include "Interview" at 8.8% (dark blue), "Organizational Report" at 7.7% (purple), and "Event Posting" at 6.6% (brown). Smaller segments include "Organizational Website" at 4.9% (light purple), "Intra-agency news article" at 4.9% (light blue), "Email" at 2.7% (light green), and "Social Media Post" at 1.1% (very light orange). The percentages are clearly labeled next to each segment, and the chart uses a color-coded system to differentiate between the various stimulus types. The central white space of the donut chart contains the title "Stimulus Type" in bold black text.
